cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You've spilled paint on my sofa. Stay there; I'll get a cloth. We can fix this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Keep blotting. You're doing well. That carpet was my birthday present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right. Good catch. Take my clean shirt. I am absolutely furious, but you are not tackling this alone.

mechanism: A stays practically supportive as its pupil repeats damaging mistakes, with the claimed teaching history sharpening its increasing anger.
confusable: Not just a cruel teacher: A continues to supply help and encouragement while its spoken frustration grows.
comparison: Damage cleanup with sacrificed property versus supporting an expensive birthday choice.
seedUse: Keep D21 paint/cloth/shirt escalation; S05 past instruction makes corrections both caring and increasingly furious.
